title: Classification with Abstention Under Class-Conditional Error Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2609.22632v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study binary classification with abstention under separate class-conditional error constraints, with the objective of minimizing abstention while keeping both errors below prescribed thresholds. We characterize the distribution-free minimax rate of excess abstention risk, up to logarithmic factors, in terms of the complexity of the hypothesis class and the sample size. To make the framework amenable to computation with models such as neural networks, we introduce surrogate-loss formulations and derive finite-sample guarantees for excess surrogate ambiguity risk. We formulate the resulting learning task as a constrained optimization problem and characterize its computational complexity in the convex setting. Finally, we evaluate our approach on various datasets and compare its performance with a competing method for this problem.

translated_title: 类条件错误约束下的带弃权分类
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在分别的类条件错误约束下的带弃权二分类问题，其目标是在保持两类错误均低于规定阈值的前提下最小化弃权率。我们以假设类的复杂度和样本量为函数，刻画了超额弃权风险在分布无关设定下的极小极大速率（精确到对数因子）。为了使该框架能够与神经网络等模型结合进行计算，我们引入了代理损失的表述形式，并为超额代理模糊风险推导了有限样本保证。我们将由此产生的学习任务表述为一个约束优化问题，并刻画了其在凸设定下的计算复杂度。最后，我们在多个数据集上评估了我们的方法，并将其性能与该问题的一种竞争方法进行了比较。
tldr: 该论文研究了在类条件错误约束下最小化弃权率的带弃权二分类问题，刻画了超额弃权风险的极小极大速率，提出了代理损失表述及有限样本保证，并将其表述为约束优化问题且分析了其计算复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper studies binary classification with abstention under class-conditional error constraints, characterizes the minimax rate of excess abstention risk, introduces surrogate-loss formulations with finite-sample guarantees, and formulates the learning task as a constrained optimization problem with characterized computational complexity.
